themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe continue to advocate for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, particularly in housing, welfare, and employment. This theme has intensified with recent electoral successes and coalition formations, reflecting a broader transnational trend toward nationalist economic and social policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in housing access, excluding immigrants from social benefits and public housing.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for prioritizing Swedish citizens in welfare and housing policies, aligning with nationalist rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes stricter immigration controls and prioritization of Norwegian citizens in public services.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Pushes for policies that favor French citizens in welfare, housing, and employment, with a focus on reducing immigration.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports policies that prioritize Italian citizens in social welfare and opposes EU migration quotas.

themes.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal dominates global discourse
themes.blurb: The Trump administration's recent peace deal with Iran has sparked intense debate across multiple countries, with right-wing and far-right parties reacting to its geopolitical and economic implications. The deal's reception varies from strong support to sharp criticism, reflecting broader ideological divides.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration promotes the deal as a diplomatic victory, emphasizing its economic benefits for the U.S.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni cautiously welcomes the deal but emphasizes the need for continued vigilance on Iran's nuclear program.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes the deal for not going far enough to curb Iran's influence in the Middle East.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Expresses skepticism about the deal's long-term stability and Iran's commitment to compliance.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Condemns the deal as a capitulation to Iran, arguing it undermines Western security interests.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in multiple countries are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and factional disputes. These conflicts often revolve around ideological purity, electoral strategies, and personal rivalries, threatening party cohesion and public perception.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega faces internal turmoil as Salvini's leadership is challenged by rising figures like Vannacci.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government faces infighting, particularly over the role of Manuel Adorni and tensions with allies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage's leadership is questioned as the party struggles to maintain unity ahead of key elections.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz faces internal dissent following its electoral defeat, with factions vying for influence.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD experiences factional disputes over leadership and ideological direction, particularly in regional branches.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei's approval ratings are declining as his government faces internal conflicts, economic challenges, and public backlash over corruption allegations. These issues are resonating across borders, with right-wing parties in other countries closely monitoring his political trajectory.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government faces declining approval due to economic policies, internal conflicts, and corruption allegations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and his allies express concern over Milei's struggles, fearing it may impact broader right-wing movements.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian far-right parties observe Milei's challenges as a cautionary tale for populist leaders.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox critiques Milei's handling of internal conflicts, drawing parallels to its own political strategies.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across multiple countries are reacting to ongoing conflicts in the Middle East, particularly the Israel-Palestine issue and the U.S.-Iran deal. These reactions often emphasize national sovereignty, security concerns, and ideological alignments with Israel or other regional actors.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Strongly supports Israel and criticizes Iran, framing the U.S.-Iran deal as a threat to regional stability.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes the U.S.-Iran deal and emphasizes France's commitment to Israel's security.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports Israel and opposes Iran's influence, aligning with U.S. policies in the region.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Expresses strong support for Israel and skepticism toward Iran, aligning with U.S. policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox strongly supports Israel and condemns Iran, framing the conflict in terms of Western security interests.
